title: Obama administration's UFO answers, then Obama's late-night statement

tellings.quote: I think as recently as like 2012, the Obama administration had was asked if they investigate UFOs and it was just kind of like left off.

plain: As recently as 2012, the Obama administration was asked whether it investigates UFOs and the question was more or less left unanswered. A researcher who goes by RedPandaKoala tells Michels this from memory, without naming a source, as an example of how lightly the White House treated the subject before Obama himself spoke about it later on late-night television.
